# Cody Iddings

> Cody Iddings helps businesses build what's worth building. He is a fractional product leader and technology consultant based in New Braunfels, Texas. He co-founded Makeshapes, a team-learning platform used by enterprises worldwide, where he leads product. He works with businesses in New Braunfels, San Antonio, Austin, and the wider Central Texas area on product leadership, web design and build, and AI and process automation.

Cody grew up on Kauaʻi, Hawaiʻi, started out as an assistant art director at Surfer Magazine, and spent fifteen years working in design, UX, and product across California and New Zealand before moving his family to New Braunfels, Texas in 2022.

He is a designer by training who still writes and ships code, so engagements can end either in a plan or in the working software. He takes on a small number of local clients at a time alongside his full-time role at Makeshapes, and offers a free one-hour strategy call with no obligation.

## Services

- **Fractional product leadership** — Working inside a product team across design, development, and delivery, bringing new ways of working and AI workflows the team genuinely adopts. Senior product leadership without a senior salary, a hiring process, or a twelve-month commitment.
- **Design & build** — Websites and software, designed and built by the same person — no agency layers. Includes honest advice on what to buy instead of build.
- **AI & process automation** — Automating intake, quoting, scheduling, follow-ups, and reporting so a team stops doing work a system should be doing.
